name: RoomLab.app
description: Official hosted MCP server for RoomLab.app. It gives any MCP client 19 tools for room and property photos: Virtual Staging, Change Style, Declutter Room, Empty Room, Replace Furniture, Replace Material, Wall Colors, Interior and Exterior Architectural Render, exterior touch-ups (blue sky, clean pool, clean garden, greener grass), Upscale Image to 4K, and Video Walkthrough, Video Transition and House Tour. Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 sign-in (dynamic client registration). Tools run on the user's RoomLab.app account and credits.
author: RoomLab.app
